headline: Three evidence-lifecycle upgrades survive live verification; five tempting fixes were rejected instead of force-greened.

items.title: Evidence-bounded incident onset
items.insight: The incident gets a defensible interval instead of one over-precise timestamp. Daily RUM evidence, coarse uptime, and route-level observations keep their own resolutions, while static deploy history is explicitly excluded.
items.evidence: RUM last healthy day 2026-07-03 · uptime first edge-degraded 2026-07-12 · route mismatch first observed 2026-07-26

items.title: Route-local shell parity receipt
items.insight: The current parity command fails against its own local homepage because its parser cannot see four asset families. Repairing the detector comes before wiring it into the existing scheduled deploy receipt, so future red means drift rather than regex folklore.
items.evidence: verify:deploy-parity EXIT 1 locally · three reported-missing assets are visibly present in index.html · parser allowlist omits them

items.title: Self-proving recovery transition
items.insight: The eventual real recovery will either close every open route exactly once or fail loudly in the publisher that observed it. Until production genuinely changes, the feed stays honest about awaiting live proof.
items.evidence: Committed ledger contains one mismatch genesis and zero recovery rows · production remains 0/5 matched

followUps: Implement all three at the L3 depth rung, then generate a second-order innovation pack.
Keep real-recovery proof open until a matched production observation exists.
blockers: Production promotion remains explicitly held; no deploy is authorized.
